description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageDecorator class, which provides additional behaviors and utility methods for EmployeeLanguage entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve fluency and competency descriptions and to associate Employee and Language entities by their identifiers.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds utility methods and relationships to the EmployeeLanguage entity, facilitating access to related entities and mapped descriptions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLanguage entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Protected method that returns the wrapped EmployeeLanguage entity.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Returns the human-readable fluency description based on the employee language's fluency code.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Returns the human-readable competency description based on the employee language's competency code.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the employee language record by employee number.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates a Language entity with the employee language record by language ID.
